# apple_game_center_app_version_compatibility (Resource)

Makes two Game Center app versions compatible, so that players on both can play multiplayer games together. Import it with `<game_center_app_version_id>/<compatible_game_center_app_version_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_app_version_compatibility" "ios_tv" {
  game_center_app_version_id            = apple_game_center_app_version.ios.id
  compatible_game_center_app_version_id = apple_game_center_app_version.tv.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `compatible_game_center_app_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center app version it is compatible with.
- `game_center_app_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center app version, e.g. `apple_game_center_app_version.example.id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_app_version_compatibility.ios_tv
  identity = {
    game_center_app_version_id            = "5c7e9a1b-3d2f-4a6b-8c0e-4f6a8b0c2d3e"
    compatible_game_center_app_version_id = "7e9a1c3d-5f2b-4c6d-8e0a-6b8c0d2e4f5a"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `compatible_game_center_app_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the compatible Game Center app version.
- `game_center_app_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center app version.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_app_version_compatibility.ios_tv 5c7e9a1b-3d2f-4a6b-8c0e-4f6a8b0c2d3e/7e9a1c3d-5f2b-4c6d-8e0a-6b8c0d2e4f5a
```
